title: Wave Speed Calculation
description: Essential: Must correctly compute wave speed using v = λ/T, obtaining approximately 31.7 m/s.

title: Propagation Direction
description: Essential: Must state that the wave propagates along the positive x-axis direction.

title: Displacement at t=1.2s
description: Essential: Must calculate displacement at x=1m, t=1.2s as -10 cm.

title: Period Determination
description: Important: Must correctly determine period T from the condition 2T < 0.6s < 2.5T and waveform shift.

title: Wavelength Identification
description: Important: Must correctly identify wavelength λ = 8 m from the waveform diagram.

title: Vibration Equation Setup
description: Important: Must correctly set up vibration equation y = A sin(ωt) with proper ω from period.

title: Phase Calculation
description: Optional: Shows correct phase calculation for specific time, including proper handling of sine function argument.

title: Sign Error in Displacement
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in final displacement (e.g., +10 cm instead of -10 cm).

title: Direction Confusion
description: Pitfall: States wrong propagation direction (negative x-axis) or omits direction entirely.

title: Unit Omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to include proper units (m/s, cm) in final answers.
